## About
Foreign Affairs concentrates on import cars and their service. We sell and service all makes and models, foreign and domestic, with complete service for late model and vintage Audi, BMW, Mercedes-Benz and Porsche.
Beyond repairs, we deal in appraisals, automobile advice, consignment, classics, custom car searches, or that hard to find part. As we like to say, "Our common bond is our uncommon enthusiasm for automobiles."
When you come in, you'll likely talk with Dick, the owner, or his colleague Jim. Our customers have given us a 4.8 rating from 31 Google reviews.

## Services
- Complete Service for Late Model and Vintage Audi, BMW, Mercedes-Benz, and Porsche: Full service for the German imports we know best, old and new.
- OEM Brake Pads, Rotors, & Caliper Replacement: Pulsating pedal or a high pitched grinding noise? We can quickly tell whether you need new brakes, and we use OEM equipment to fix it right.
- Airbag, Battery, Check Engine, Oil Pressure, ABS Light Service, & More: Service lights on? Don't ignore it. Let us diagnose the problem. We have the right tools to get those pesky lights off.
- Timing Belt, Tensioner, Thermostat, & Water Pump Replacement: A broken timing belt can severely damage your engine. Let us inspect yours.
- Shocks, Struts, Bushings, & Other Suspension Replacement: Hearing clunks over bumps? From air suspension to coil over conversions, we have you covered.
- Interstate Batteries: Trouble starting your car? We install Interstate batteries that carry a nationwide warranty and can be replaced anywhere Interstate is sold.
- Appraisals, Automobile Advice, Consignment: Thinking about selling, buying or valuing a car? Come talk it over with us.
- Classics, Custom Car Searches, or that Hard to Find Part: We sell classics and can help track down a specific car or that part nobody else seems to have.

## FAQ
Q: Do you only work on foreign cars?
A: No. We concentrate on imports, but we sell and service all makes and models, foreign and domestic.

Q: Why should I have my timing belt checked?
A: If a timing belt breaks, it can severely damage your engine and lead to all kinds of headaches. Let us inspect yours.

Q: How do I know if I need a new battery?
A: If you're having trouble starting and your battery is more than 5 years old, it may be time for a new one.

Q: If I buy a car from you, can you help with shipping?
A: Shipping costs are the buyer's responsibility, but we can give you references for shippers.

## What customers say
- "As teenagers, our parents provide us with many life lessons. One of them is that whenever a vehicle requires maintenance or repair, you should take it to an authorized dealership (usually where you bought it) because local mechanics can't always be trusted. However, after the first year of owning a used Mini Cooper and facing nearly $6,000 in repairs, I received advice that challenged this belief. Someone suggested I take my vehicle to Foreign Affairs Auto Service.

Instead of driving into a paved lot with arrows directing me to a service department to speak with a service advisor, I walked through a metal door and spoke directly with the owner, "Dick." With decades of experience and a reputation for integrity, Dick instantly earned my trust. Both he and his colleague Jim completely understood my frustrations with previous repair experiences. They never tried to upsell me; if they recommended maintenance, it was genuinely necessary.

The life lesson I learned four decades ago is only partially true. It applies if a vehicle has a manufacturer’s warranty or maintenance plan that comes with complimentary espresso and a comfortable waiting area. Otherwise, when integrity, expertise, and cost are priorities, Foreign Affairs Auto Service is the clear choice." (Jay E P, 5/5)
